```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


**Purpose:**
Processes bulk RNA-seq datasets and generates the DESeq2 objects for use in downstream analyses

**Datasets:**
1. Internal RNA-seq dataset 1
2. Internal RNA-seq dataset 2
3. DuBose et al.
4. Celeste et al.
5. Kwong et al.
6. Hugo et al. 

**Outputs:**
DESeq2 objects for each dataset for use in downstream analyses.


# Set up necessary background

## Libraries

```{r}
suppressMessages(library(DESeq2))
suppressMessages(library(GEOquery))
suppressMessages(library(here))
```

## Generate Location to save Files
```{r}
# sraProj <- "data_objects"
resultsDir1 <- here("data", "data_objects")

# Automatically create the folder on the computer if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(resultsDir1)) {
  dir.create(resultsDir1, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Add location of counts files heres
pathToCounts <- "C:/path/to/Counts"
```

# Internal Datasets

# RNA-seq dataset 1 (overexpression)

**Source:** GEO GSE352223


```{r}
# get all the bulk rna data
files <- data.frame(fname = list.files(file.path(path = pathToCounts, "GSE352223"), pattern = "*.q4_sorted.counts"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

csv_files <- list.files(path = (file.path(path = pathToCounts, "GSE352223")), pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(csv_files) > 0) {
  metadata_oe <- read.csv(csv_files[1])
  message("Successfully loaded: ", basename(csv_files[1]))
} else {
  stop("No CSV files found in the directory!")
}

metadata_oe$condition <- factor(metadata_oe$condition)

dds_OE <- DESeqDataSetFromHTSeqCount(
  sampleTable = metadata_oe,
  directory = file.path(pathToCounts, "GSE352223"),
  design = ~condition
)

# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_OE)) >= 10
dds_OE <- dds_OE[keep, ]
dds_OE <- DESeq(dds_OE)

# save dds object
saveRDS(object = dds_OE, file = file.path(resultsDir1, "dds_OE.rds"))
```

## Tiago et al

**Source:** GEO GSE228600

**Inputs:**
Load DESeq2 object generated using the preprocessing pipeline described in
[Tiago et al./https://github.com/AplinLabBioinformatics/Tiago_NR2F1/tree/main/code]. This DESeq2 object was used as the input for the analyses presented in this paper. 

# External Datasets

## DuBose et al. Dataset

**Source:** GEO GSE255541


```{r}
# get all the bulk rna data
files <- data.frame(fname = list.files(file.path(path = pathToCounts, "GSE255541"), pattern = "*.q4_sorted.counts"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

csv_files <- list.files(path = (file.path(path = pathToCounts, "GSE255541")), pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(csv_files) > 0) {
  metadata_dubose <- read.csv(csv_files[1])
  message("Successfully loaded: ", basename(csv_files[1]))
} else {
  stop("No CSV files found in the directory!")
}

metadata_dubose$grp <- factor(metadata_dubose$grp) 
metadata_dubose$pseudotime <- factor(metadata_dubose$pseudotime, levels = c("0","1","7"))
metadata_dubose$treatment <- factor(metadata_dubose$treatment, levels = c("DMSO","dabrafenib"))
metadata_dubose$treat.time <- factor(metadata_dubose$treat.time, levels = c("DT_0","DT_1","DT_7"))
metadata_dubose$repl <- factor(metadata_dubose$repl)


metadata_dubose$condition <- paste0(metadata_dubose$grp, ".", metadata_dubose$treat.time)
metadata_dubose$condition <- factor(metadata_dubose$condition)

dds_dubose <- DESeqDataSetFromHTSeqCount(
  sampleTable = metadata_dubose,
  directory = file.path(pathToCounts, "GSE255541"),
  design = ~condition
)

# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_dubose)) >= 10
dds_dubose <- dds_dubose[keep, ]
dds_dubose <- DESeq(dds_dubose)

# save dds object
saveRDS(object = dds_dubose, file = file.path(resultsDir1, "dds_dubose.rds"))
```

## Su et al. Dataset

**Source:** EMTAB5493
 

```{r Su_EMTAB5493}
# get all the bulk rna data
files <- data.frame(fname = list.files(file.path(path = pathToCounts, "EMTAB5493"), pattern = "*.q4_sorted.counts"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

csv_files <- list.files(path = (file.path(path = pathToCounts, "EMTAB5493")), pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(csv_files) > 0) {
  metadata_su <- read.csv(csv_files[1])
  message("Successfully loaded: ", basename(csv_files[1]))
} else {
  stop("No CSV files found in the directory!")
}

metadata_su$cell_line <- factor(metadata_su$cell_line)
metadata_su$treatment <- factor(metadata_su$treatment)
metadata_su$timepoint <- factor(metadata_su$timepoint, levels = c("0", "3", "21", "73", "90", "none"))

metadata_su$condition <- paste0(
  metadata_su$cell_line, ".",
  metadata_su$treatment, ".",
  metadata_su$timepoint
)


dds_su <- DESeqDataSetFromHTSeqCount(sampleTable = metadata_su, 
                                     directory = file.path(pathToCounts, "EMTAB5493"), 
                                     design = ~cell_line)

# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_su)) >= 10
dds_su <- dds_su[keep, ]
dds_su <- DESeq(dds_su)

# save dds object
saveRDS(object = dds_su, file = file.path(resultsDir1, "dds_su.rds"))
```

## Kwong et al. Dataset

**Source:** EGAD00001001306

EGAD00001001306 is a controlled-access EGA dataset.The processed expression data used in this analysis were provided by the lab. Analysis begins from the provided processed expression matrix.

## Hugo et al. Dataset

**Source:** GEO GSE65185

```{r}
# get all the bulk rna data
files <- list.files(
    file.path(pathToCounts, "GSE65185"),
    pattern = "\\.q4_sorted\\.counts$",
    full.names = TRUE
)


count_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    df <- read.table(f, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # Assign column names
    colnames(df) <- c("ENSG","HUGO", "COUNT")
    
    # Remove version suffix from ENSG (e.g., .12, .5, .01)
    df$ENSG <- sub("\\..*", "", df$ENSG)
    
    # Use SRR ID as sample name
    sample_name <- sub("\\.q4_sorted\\.counts$", "", basename(f))
    colnames(df)[3] <- sample_name  # rename COUNT column
    
    df
})


merged_counts <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = c("ENSG", "HUGO"), all = TRUE),
  count_list
)

# ensure is NA doesn't break things
merged_counts[is.na(merged_counts)] <- 0

# remove extra row
merged_counts <- merged_counts[!grepl("^__", merged_counts$ENSG), ]

# rename rownames
rownames(merged_counts) <- merged_counts$ENSG
merged_counts$ENSG <- NULL

# remove hugo file
merged_counts$HUGO <- NULL


sample_info <- data.frame(
  condition = rep("sample", ncol(merged_counts))
)

rownames(sample_info) <- colnames(merged_counts)


dds_hugo <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = merged_counts,
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ 1
)


# save Hugo dds object
saveRDS(object = dds_hugo, file = file.path(resultsDir1, "dds_hugo.rds"))

```
